```{r}
#| context: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(grid)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 2.55,
  dpi = 120,
  out.width = "100%"
)

read_history <- function(path) {
  files <- list.files(
    path,
    pattern = "\\.csv$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  if (length(files) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(
    files,
    ~ readr::read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)
  )
}

to_tib <- function(x) {
  x / 1024^4
}

maintenance_states <- c(
  "MAINT",
  "DRAIN",
  "DRAINED",
  "DRAINING"
)

alert_states <- c(
  "DOWN",
  "FAIL",
  "FAILING",
  "NO_RESPOND",
  "INVAL",
  "UNKNOWN"
)

theme_beagle <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        size = 13,
        margin = margin(r = 7)
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 7, 5, 7)
    )
}

cluster_current <- read_csv(
  "../data/dashboard/cluster/current.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

node_current <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(
    "../data/dashboard/beagle-01/current.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ),
  read_csv(
    "../data/dashboard/beagle-02/current.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ),
  read_csv(
    "../data/dashboard/beagle-gpu-01/current.csv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
)

gpu_current <- read_csv(
  "../data/dashboard/beagle-gpu-01/gpu.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cluster_history <- read_history(
  "../data/dashboard/cluster/history"
)

node_history <- bind_rows(
  read_history("../data/dashboard/beagle-01/history"),
  read_history("../data/dashboard/beagle-02/history"),
  read_history("../data/dashboard/beagle-gpu-01/history")
)

gpu_history <- read_history(
  "../data/dashboard/beagle-gpu-01/gpu_history"
)

cluster_current <- cluster_current |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = with_tz(
      ymd_hms(timestamp),
      "America/Mexico_City"
    )
  )

node_current <- node_current |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = with_tz(
      ymd_hms(timestamp),
      "America/Mexico_City"
    )
  )

gpu_current <- gpu_current |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = with_tz(
      ymd_hms(timestamp),
      "America/Mexico_City"
    )
  )

cluster_history <- cluster_history |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = with_tz(
      ymd_hms(timestamp),
      "America/Mexico_City"
    )
  )

node_history <- node_history |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = with_tz(
      ymd_hms(timestamp),
      "America/Mexico_City"
    )
  )

gpu_history <- gpu_history |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = with_tz(
      ymd_hms(timestamp),
      "America/Mexico_City"
    )
  )

last_update <- max(
  cluster_current$timestamp,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

storage_used <- to_tib(
  cluster_current$storage_used_bytes
)

storage_total <- to_tib(
  cluster_current$storage_total_bytes
)

storage_available <- to_tib(
  cluster_current$storage_available_bytes
)

node_status_check <- node_current |>
  mutate(
    state = toupper(state)
  )

node_maintenance <- node_status_check |>
  filter(
    str_detect(
      state,
      paste(maintenance_states, collapse = "|")
    )
  )

node_alert <- node_status_check |>
  filter(
    str_detect(
      state,
      paste(alert_states, collapse = "|")
    )
  )

cluster_status <- case_when(
  nrow(node_alert) > 0 ~ "ALERTA",
  nrow(node_maintenance) > 0 ~ "MANT.",
  TRUE ~ "OK"
)

cluster_icon <- case_when(
  cluster_status == "OK" ~ "check-circle",
  cluster_status == "MANT." ~ "tools",
  TRUE ~ "exclamation-triangle"
)

cluster_color <- case_when(
  cluster_status == "OK" ~ "success",
  cluster_status == "MANT." ~ "warning",
  TRUE ~ "danger"
)

last_timestamp <- max(
  cluster_history$timestamp,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

nodes_24h <- node_history |>
  filter(
    timestamp >= last_timestamp - hours(24)
  )

gpu_24h <- gpu_history |>
  filter(
    timestamp >= last_timestamp - hours(24)
  )

nodes_daily <- node_history |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    date,
    node
  ) |>
  summarise(
    cpu_mean = mean(
      cpu_used_pct,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    ram_mean = mean(
      ram_used_bytes / ram_total_bytes * 100,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gpu_daily <- gpu_history |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(timestamp),
    gpu = paste("GPU", gpu),
    memory_pct =
      memory_used_mib / memory_total_mib * 100
  ) |>
  group_by(
    date,
    gpu
  ) |>
  summarise(
    utilization_mean = mean(
      utilization_pct,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    memory_mean = mean(
      memory_pct,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    temperature_mean = mean(
      temperature_c,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    power_mean = mean(
      power_w,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Row {height=220}

```{r}
#| title: "Estado de los nodos"

node_status <- node_current |>
  transmute(
    Nodo = node,
    Partición = partition,
    Estado = toupper(state),
    `CPU asignadas` =
      paste0(cpu_alloc, "/", cpu_total),
    `CPU real (%)` =
      round(cpu_used_pct, 1),
    `RAM (%)` =
      round(
        ram_used_bytes / ram_total_bytes * 100,
        1
      )
  )

knitr::kable(
  node_status,
  align = "lccccc"
)
```

```{r}
#| title: "CPU utilizada"

node_current |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(node, cpu_used_pct),
      y = cpu_used_pct
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_beagle()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Memoria RAM"

node_current |>
  mutate(
    ram_pct =
      ram_used_bytes / ram_total_bytes * 100
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(node, ram_pct),
      y = ram_pct
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

```

## Row {height=215}

```{r}
#| title: "Almacenamiento /home/ib"

tibble(
  categoria = c(
    "Utilizado",
    "Disponible"
  ),
  tib = c(
    storage_used,
    storage_available
  )
) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = "",
      y = tib,
      fill = categoria
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.45) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "TiB",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_beagle() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| title: "GPU V100 — estado actual"

gpu_current |>
  mutate(
    gpu = paste("GPU", gpu)
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = gpu,
      y = utilization_pct
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(width = 0.60) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.02)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Utilización"
  ) +
  theme_beagle()
```

::: {.card title="Última actualización"}

**Última medición recibida**

`r format(last_update, "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M")`

**Almacenamiento**

`r sprintf("%.1f TiB utilizados de %.1f TiB", storage_used, storage_total)`

**Disponible**

`r sprintf("%.1f TiB", storage_available)`

:::
